title: Blenders: High-Performance, Full-Size and Personal
metaDescription: Our blender research: the best blenders for smoothies, soups and frozen drinks, plus a guide to choosing the right type.
lede: From single-serve smoothie blenders to high-performance machines that make hot soup, find the blender that fits what you actually make.

p: If you know you want a blender but not which type, read the buying guide first. If you already know your budget, the best blenders list gives one strong pick per type.
